text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oho. On PR Committee business-san,
you want to interview Machan... is that it?

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. For our next issue's column,
we would absolutely love to write an article on Machan-san...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see.
Machan's photos and words shall be engraved
in the school newspaper, then—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...However, I must decline!

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: Eh, n-no way...! Why is that?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What is a mascot, what is an adorable form...
Machan's philosophy is—
something that cannot be fully expressed in words.

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... I understand that completely...!
However, Machan-san's philosophy is something
I wish to record for history...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hmph. In that case—a photobomb showdown it is.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple. If you don't let Machan
photobomb you, it's Chrono-san's win.
If Machan can photobomb, it's Machan's win.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In other words, if you can take even a single photo
without Machan in it, I shall grant you an interview~.

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
Eh... Ah...!
...She's gone...

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
If I can take even one photo of Chan-san
without her photobombing it, I win...

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: For now... here goes!

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
Huh, she's in it...!?
B-But I made sure she wasn't
in sight anywhere...!

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
...In that case,
I'll shoot way over there—!

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
...Kh!?
Did she just teleport!?

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: No way, how did she...!?

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, with Chan-san's overwhelming speed
suited for sprints, and that explosive power to take
the lead right out of the gate—

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
This is... thrilling.
As expected of the unforgettable flower blooming on the turf,
Aston Machan...!

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, I absolutely have to write an article about this!
I can't lose this showdown...!

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: Take this!

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: Kuh, this time for sure!

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
!?
Again...!?

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, it's my... complete defeat...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe...
Flawless victory, it is. Peace sign.

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, how pathetic of me...!
Not only did I lose, but now I can't even
write an article about your greatness, Machan-san...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...No.
Machan won the match, yes—
but you won the real showdown, Chrono-san.

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Because Machan's heart
was truly moved.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In honor of your nice fight—
I shall gladly grant you an interview.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's insane~~!
Machan completely swept the photobomb showdown!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, "Bazooka Lens VS Photobomber"...?
That headline is way too powerful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Horse girls are buzzing excitedly,
school newspapers in hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aside from the column being genuinely entertaining...
the photos from that bizarre condition showdown
certainly grab your attention.
choice_data_list: This really did... make quite a splash.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Total satisfaction.
Mission accomplished.
choice_data_list: It was a really fun read!
...Wait, did you plan for it to turn out like this?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, right? Isn't it just?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Also, the photos taken during that time
are currently posted on Machan's blog.
In high resolution and full color.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Please do drop by and take a look.
And get to know Machan more, so much more...
okay?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
Now then, what's next?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Machan is always working hard with wide, sparkling eyes
so that everyone remembers her.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm working so hard...
you'll root for me, right?
